# GA403WR in Hybrid with nouveau bound headless (modeset=2, ANAL-243; synthetic): nouveau's card has no
# connectors and its render node follows amdgpu's. The panel stays on the 890M, and so do the composer and gralloc.
fw mux=1 dgpu=0
drm card0 driver=amdgpu pci=0000:65:00.0 vendor=0x1002 device=0x150e class=0x038000 conn=DP-1:disconnected,eDP-1:connected
drm card1 driver=nouveau pci=0000:64:00.0 vendor=0x10de device=0x2f58 class=0x030000
render renderD128 driver=amdgpu pci=0000:65:00.0 vendor=0x1002 device=0x150e class=0x038000
render renderD129 driver=nouveau pci=0000:64:00.0 vendor=0x10de device=0x2f58 class=0x030000
pci 0000:64:00.0 driver=nouveau vendor=0x10de device=0x2f58 class=0x030000
pci 0000:65:00.0 driver=amdgpu vendor=0x1002 device=0x150e class=0x038000
